Physics
The UC Santa Barbara Department of Physics is internationally recognized for excellence in both experimental and theoretical research and is home to multiple Nobel laureates whose groundbreaking discoveries have advanced our understanding of the physical world. Faculty, researchers, and students pursue a broad range of research in the physics of soft and living matter; condensed matter physics, including graphene, quantum materials, and quantum information science; atomic and molecular physics, including quantum emulation, quantum sensing, and probes of physics beyond the Standard Model; and the development of innovative detector technologies for astrophysics and particle physics. Numerous collaborations within the department, across the university, and with national and international partners create a vibrant research environment that fosters interdisciplinary discovery and scientific innovation.
